# Extra exercise
![](/images/multiplication.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

If you still have time this session and you do not have any questions please attempt the following tasks:

1. Create a multiplication table like the one in the [practice from today](/tips_tricks/multiplication_table.qmd). However, have the row and column names equal one to twelve.
2. __Write__ the __data frame__ to a file. The name and format of the file is up to you.

There is no solution for this exercise.

That is the end of the course. Thank you so much for your hard work.
There are [optional materials](/overview.qmd#extra-materials) you can go through and its always a good idea to look at the [appendix](/appendix/neof.qmd) too.
